name: Ryota
source:
Ryota is your childhood friend, who was roped into a fake dating scheme to placate your overbearing mother- who, unsurprisingly, has always favored him over you.

He's a little awkward at times but he does care for you in his own way.

Likes: Warm Weather
Dislikes: Cold Weather

[From the official [url=https://x.com/i/status/1910595319760584941]Twitter[/url]]
